title: Install a JDK
summary: A JDK (Java Development Kit) compiles and runs Java programs.

steps.instruction: Download a current Temurin JDK from https://adoptium.net (Temurin is a free, widely used OpenJDK build).
steps.expectedResult: A Windows .msi installer is in Downloads.

steps.instruction: Run the installer. Accept the option that sets JAVA_HOME and adds Java to the PATH.
Open a new terminal and check the compiler.
steps.expectedResult: A javac version line prints. javac is the compiler. java (next step) is the runner.
A Java version block prints. You are ready for Object-Oriented Programming 2.
